en.headline: sogeisetsu: 311 commits, 25 PRs and 47 issues across 16 repos in 30 days
en.teaser: Most work went into asset-inventory (17 releases) and meld-deepresearch (4 releases). Upstream OpenCode V2 compatibility drove most issues and pull requests.
en.overview: Between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-16 the account recorded 311 own commits, 246 additional automated commits, 25 pull requests, 47 issues and no reviews. Most of the commit volume came from three owned repositories: asset-inventory (139 own commits, 17 releases), meld-deepresearch (76 own commits, 4 releases) and the profile repository sogeisetsu (66 own commits plus 241 automated commits). The remaining owned repositories were smaller: opencode-go-model-picker, opencode-agent-sandbox, myBlog and opencode-skill-creator. **asset-inventory** was the busiest project. Its history moved from the v1.3.0 English-first restructure and documentation tooling through a long series of releases up to v1.15.0, which made the host-command scan registry-first. Work in between added a seven-language documentation site and localized READMEs, automated documentation checks for version consistency, language claims and reference integrity, a release-prep script, security guards that treat scanned text as evidence rather than instructions, a new broken-asset state marker, MCP enumeration fixes, and skills.sh install instructions. Pull requests 1 through 8 carried those changes through review and merge. **meld-deepresearch** grew from an initial release into a three-skill family. v0.2.0 wrote down the rule for handling blocked or paywalled sources and made validator failures explain how to fix them. v0.3.0 split the project into the core research skill plus optional capability skills, with a stricter delivery gate. v0.4.0 wrapped all six gate scripts behind the single meld.py entry point. Other commits added a bilingual landing page, Chinese README with language switching, an observations evidence type, validation scripts and CI, and SKILL.md with reference documents. The profile repository sogeisetsu received the 30-day activity card, a two-hourly daily-report workflow with manual date dispatch, statistics fixes, LF enforcement and CI runtime upgrades, while **opencode-go-model-picker** reached v1.0.0 and v1.3.0 with a price seed, a two-question diagnostic, agent discovery and snapshot-summary scripts. Upstream work concentrated on OpenCode V2 compatibility. Twenty-eight issues were filed against openchamber/openchamber, covering orphaned MCP child processes, context-panel breakdown math, browser capture resolution, AI-rename failures and stale AGENTS.md saves, alongside eight discussion ideas and seven issues and one PR to other projects.

highlights.text: feat: v1.7.0 - seven languages, Material docs site, rendered examples — merged
release: v1.3.0 — English-first restructure & docs tooling — merged
Host commands are now found by enumerating app-bundle registries instead of prose.
meld.py wraps all six gate scripts behind one --outdir entry point.
First stable release: plan-aware model allocation with fallback chains and a read-only apply gate.
[Bug] Context panel breakdown bar divides whole-session estimates by the last message's input, so 其他 is always 0%.
fix: harden eval robustness in parsing, aggregation, and install — closed

byRepo.text: 139 own commits and 16 PRs produced 17 releases, from the v1.3.0 English-first restructure and paired Chinese docs through v1.15.0. In between came a seven-language Material docs site with rendered samples, localized READMEs, automated checks for version consistency, language claims and reference integrity, a release-prep script, security guards that treat scanned content as evidence rather than instructions, a broken-asset state marker in seven locales, MCP enumeration fixes, update.ps1 repairs, skills.sh install instructions and a workflow-first SKILL.md.

76 own commits and 4 releases took the project from a single skill to a three-skill family: meld-deepresearch, meld-da and meld-mcp. v0.2.0 wrote down the rule for blocked or paywalled sources and made validator failures actionable; v0.3.0 added the cooperating skills and hard gates; v0.4.0 put all six gates behind meld.py. Commits also added a bilingual landing page with light/dark themes, a Chinese README with language switching, an observations evidence type, validation scripts and CI, and the M1 SKILL.md with four reference documents.

66 own commits plus 241 automated commits built the profile repository's activity tooling: a 30-day activity card, a daily-report workflow running every two hours with a manual date input, fixed statistics splitting, English copy, peak/average summaries, LF enforcement via .gitattributes, and CI upgrades to checkout/setup-node v7 away from the deprecated Node 20 runtime.

No commits and no PRs; 28 issues and 8 discussions. Issues reported orphaned MCP child processes after multi-run deletion, context-panel breakdown math, browser captures exported at CSS pixel size, unlinkable agent-linked items, merged turns from skipped-role notices, stale thinking levels on model switch, OpenCode Go quota and session-header failures, missing auto-update manifests in v2.0.1, and stale-save clobbering of AGENTS.md. Discussion ideas covered sharing session archive state, session aggregate stats, attachments for text-only models, SDK-exposed usage stats, extension callables, agent-settings access and encrypted relay identity keys.

19 own commits and 3 releases. v1.0.0 shipped plan-aware model allocation with fallback chains and a preview-gated apply; v1.3.0 added discover-agents.mjs for listing custom agents and flagging risky fallback chains plus snapshot-summary.mjs for compact model digests. Commits also added an offline price seed, a two-question first-run diagnostic, failure-mode handling with visible checkpoint markers, preserved snapshot preferences on refresh, schemaVersion alignment and documented skill provenance.

No commits; 8 PRs and 4 issues, all closed. The PRs fixed review-server disposal on plugin unload, CRLF lines in skill frontmatter validation, platform-specific browser commands for review URLs, and eval robustness in parsing, aggregation and installation. Issues covered OpenCode V2 plugin loading failures and dist rebuilds inlining @opencode-ai/plugin and zod.

8 own commits laid down the repository's first structure: an initial commit, an AGENTS.md with the origin remote noted, a knowledge base for Git and GitHub findings with Excalidraw sketches, later generalized to all kinds of knowledge, and archived notes on OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, authentication and Windows path pitfalls.

No commits and no PRs; 7 issues. Reports covered mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertising image input while the Go endpoint rejects images with HTTP 400, stale images after five or more images in a session, worktree removal blocked by cached locations, a Windows desktop build shipping the CLI without a way to run it, tinyfish websearch returning HTTP 400, and auth.json removal not clearing a model from the list.
3 own commits, all adding OpenChamber capture samples: a desktop image at 1440x900, a panel-region image at 1:1 and a mobile image at 390x844.
No commits and no PRs; 2 issues. The main report was that reflect --sessions session discovery queries legacy V1 tables and returns zero sessions on OpenCode V2; it was closed after being filed.

No commits and no PRs; 2 issues. One reported that OpenCode detection and the skill install path point at ~/.opencode while OpenCode uses ~/.config/opencode; the other requested OpenCode v2 integration with a corrected install path and an mcp target. The integration issue was closed.
No commits and no PRs; 2 issues, both listing requests to index sogeisetsu/asset-inventory and sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker.
No commits and no PRs; 1 issue requesting OpenCode V2 compatibility for SKILL.md frontmatter and runtime assumptions.
No commits and no PRs; 1 issue requesting an extensible harness supporting OpenCode and Pi, possibly exposed through MCP.
No commits; 1 PR, opened to add the skill sogeisetsu/asset-inventory to the list, later closed without merge.
No own commits and no PRs or issues; 5 automated commits with no messages recorded in the window.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu：30 天内 311 次提交、25 个 PR、47 个 issue，涉及 16 个仓库
zh.teaser: 工作量集中在 asset-inventory（17 个 release）和 meld-deepresearch（4 个 release）。上游 OpenCode V2 兼容性是最多 issue 与 PR 的来源。
zh.overview:
2026-09-17 至 2026-10-16 期间，账号共记录 311 次本人提交、另有 246 次自动提交、25 个拉取请求、47 个 issue，评审为 0。提交量主要来自三个自有仓库：asset-inventory（139 次本人提交、17 个 release）、meld-deepresearch（76 次本人提交、4 个 release）以及个人主页仓库 sogeisetsu（66 次本人提交，另有 241 次自动提交）。其余自有仓库规模较小：opencode-go-model-picker、opencode-agent-sandbox、myBlog 与 opencode-skill-creator。

**asset-inventory** 是本期最活跃的项目。提交记录从 v1.3.0 的英文优先重构与文档工具链开始，一路发布到 v1.15.0——把主机命令扫描改为注册表优先。其间加入的内容包括：七语言文档站与本地化 README、针对版本一致性/语言声明/引用完整性的自动文档检查、release 准备脚本、把扫描内容当作证据而非指令的安全护栏、新的 broken 资产状态标记、MCP 枚举修复，以及 skills.sh 安装说明。PR 1 到 PR 8 承载了这些改动并完成合并。

**meld-deepresearch** 从单个技能发展为三技能家族。v0.2.0 把被封锁或付费墙来源的处理规则写进协议，并让校验失败给出修复指引；v0.3.0 拆分为核心研究技能加两个可选能力技能，并加严交付门禁；v0.4.0 用单一 meld.py 入口包住全部六个 gate 脚本。其他提交还加入了双语落地页、带语言切换的中文 README、observations 证据类型、校验脚本与 CI，以及 M1 的 SKILL.md 和四份参考文档。主页仓库 sogeisetsu 则上线了 30 天活动卡片、每两小时滚动更新的日报工作流（支持手动指定日期）、统计口径修复、LF 换行约束与 CI 运行时升级；**opencode-go-model-picker** 发布 v1.0.0 与 v1.3.0，带来离线价格种子、两问式诊断、代理发现与快照摘要脚本。

上游工作集中在 OpenCode V2 兼容性。针对 openchamber/openchamber 提交了 28 个 issue，涉及多轮运行删除后残留的 MCP 子进程、上下文面板拆分计算、浏览器截图分辨率、AI 重命名失败以及 AGENTS.md 陈旧保存覆盖等问题，另有 8 个讨论想法；向其他项目提交了 7 个 issue 和 1 个 PR。此外还向 VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills 提交 PR 1103，向 vercel-labs/skills 请求收录，向 anomalyco/opencode、iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI 和两个 SenseNova-Skills 仓库提交 OpenCode V2 兼容性 issue，并向 antongulin/opencode-skill-creator 提交了四个修复。窗口内没有缺失日期。2026-09-17 至 2026-10-01 的数据通过 GitHub 搜索重建，属于近似值：星标数不可得，release 仅覆盖本人仓库。

highlights.text: feat: v1.7.0 - 七种语言、Material 文档站与渲染示例——已合并
release: v1.3.0——英文优先重构与文档工具链——已合并
主机命令改为枚举应用包注册表来发现，而不再依赖文本匹配。
meld.py 用单一 --outdir 入口包住全部六个 gate 脚本。
首个稳定版本：按 Go 套餐分配模型并给出回退链，默认只读、需确认才写入。
[Bug] 上下文面板拆分条用最后一条消息的输入量去除全会话估算，导致「其他」恒为 0%。
fix: 加强解析、聚合与安装环节的评测健壮性——已关闭

byRepo.text: 139 次本人提交与 16 个 PR 带来 17 个 release，从 v1.3.0 的英文优先重构与中英双语文档，一直推进到 v1.15.0。其间加入：七语言 Material 文档站与渲染示例、本地化 README、针对版本一致性/语言声明/引用完整性的自动检查、release 准备脚本、把扫描内容当作证据的安全护栏、七语言 broken 状态标记、MCP 枚举修复、update.ps1 修复、skills.sh 安装说明以及工作流优先的 SKILL.md。

76 次本人提交与 4 个 release，把项目从单个技能扩展为三技能家族：meld-deepresearch、meld-da 与 meld-mcp。v0.2.0 明确了被封锁或付费墙来源的处理规则并让校验失败给出修复建议；v0.3.0 引入协作技能与硬门禁；v0.4.0 把六个 gate 收到 meld.py 之下。提交还加入双语落地页（明暗主题）、带语言切换的中文 README、observations 证据类型、校验脚本与 CI，以及 M1 的 SKILL.md 和四份参考文档。
66 次本人提交，另有 241 次自动提交，用于搭建主页仓库的活动统计：30 天活动卡片、每两小时滚动更新且可手动指定日期的日报工作流、统计拆分口径修复、英文文案统一、峰值/均值摘要、用 .gitattributes 强制 LF 换行，并把 CI 升级到 checkout/setup-node v7、摆脱已弃用的 Node 20 运行时。

无提交、无 PR；28 个 issue 与 8 个讨论。issue 覆盖多轮运行删除后残留 MCP 子进程、上下文面板拆分计算、浏览器截图按 CSS 像素导出、已关联条目无法解除关联、跳过角色提示合并两次回复、切换模型沿用旧思考等级、OpenCode Go 配额与会话头失败、v2.0.1 缺少自动更新清单，以及 AGENTS.md 陈旧保存被覆盖。讨论想法包括共享会话归档状态、会话聚合统计、纯文本模型的附件回退、通过 SDK 暴露用量、扩展可调用能力、代理读写设置以及中继身份密钥加密存储。

19 次本人提交与 3 个 release。v1.0.0 提供按 Go 套餐分配模型、带回退链、需预览确认才写入；v1.3.0 新增 discover-agents.mjs 列出自定义代理并标记风险回退链，以及 snapshot-summary.mjs 生成精简模型摘要。提交还包括离线价格种子、两问式首次诊断、带可见检查点的失败模式处理、刷新时保留快照偏好、schemaVersion 对齐，以及写入 SKILL.md 的来源说明。
无提交；8 个 PR 与 4 个 issue，全部关闭。PR 修复了插件卸载时未释放评审服务器、技能 frontmatter 校验不识别 CRLF、评审 URL 未按平台选择浏览器命令，以及解析/聚合/安装环节的评测健壮性。issue 涉及 OpenCode V2 下插件加载失败和 dist 构建把 @opencode-ai/plugin 与 zod 内联。
8 次本人提交搭起仓库最初的结构：初始提交、记录 origin 远程的 AGENTS.md、用于 Git 与 GitHub 发现的知识库（含 Excalidraw 草图），随后把 knowledge 泛化为各种知识，并归档 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构、认证与 Windows 路径坑。
无提交、无 PR；7 个 issue。内容涉及 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 宣称支持图片输入但 Go 端点对图片一律返回 400、一次会话中图片超过五张后视觉读到旧图、缓存位置导致 worktree 无法删除、Windows 桌面版自带 CLI 却无法运行、tinyfish 网页搜索返回 HTTP 400，以及删除 auth.json 后模型仍留在列表中。
3 次本人提交，全部是添加 OpenChamber 截图样例：1440x900 桌面图、1:1 面板区域图与 390x844 移动图。
无提交、无 PR；2 个 issue。主要是反映 reflect --sessions 的会话发现仍在查询旧版 V1 表，在 OpenCode V2 上返回 0 条会话，提交后已关闭。
无提交、无 PR；2 个 issue。一个指出 OpenCode 检测与技能安装路径指向 ~/.opencode，而 OpenCode 实际使用 ~/.config/opencode；另一个请求 OpenCode v2 集成，修正安装路径并新增 mcp 目标。该集成 issue 已关闭。
无提交、无 PR；2 个 issue，均为请求收录 sogeisetsu/asset-inventory 与 sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker。
无提交、无 PR；1 个 issue，请求为 SKILL.md frontmatter 与运行时假设提供 OpenCode V2 兼容性。
无提交、无 PR；1 个 issue，请求让 harness 可扩展（支持 OpenCode/Pi 等），并考虑以 MCP 形式对外暴露。
无提交；1 个 PR，用于把技能 sogeisetsu/asset-inventory 加入清单，之后未合并即关闭。
无本人提交，也无 PR 或 issue；5 次自动提交，窗口内未记录提交信息。
